plan.problem: Backend seed writes Burn state, while GPU random kernels consume a separate CubeCL RNG. Diagnostic runs differ in initial rotations and opacity before SGD.
plan.change: Also seed the CubeCL generator from the CLI seed before loading the dataset. Other ordering/sampling fixes are held constant.
plan.measurement: Eight serial diagnostic trainings on the same instrumented binary, with GPU state captures at 0/1/10/100 updates. Do not treat snapshot timings as production speed.
plan.acceptance: Real normal/uniform Tensor random output must repeat when seeded; verify full initial PLY and early-update equality separately from final-model repeatability and quality.

raw_runs.measurement: adapter training, evaluation and export; excludes SfM and input copy

timing_scope: Adapter training/evaluation/export with the same instrumented local binary; excludes source compilation, SfM and input copy. OS/driver caches not flushed. Image trace is enabled equally in both variants.
quality_scope: Frozen historical shared-camera scenes; every eighth image held out from training but used in SfM. Compare RGB PSNR and Gaussian-window SSIM at long edge 512. Two repeats are exploratory.

state_observation_scope.limitations: Snapshots read tensors back from the GPU and may change execution scheduling. Exported parameters do not include optimizer state or raw unnormalized quaternion values.
state_observation_scope.timing: Includes snapshot readback and write overhead; not a production speed comparison.
